requirement.description: View construction fails with "Object (sig v) is not a data view" error when trying to construct Views from Signals with layouts.
requirement.contract: View constructor should properly accept Signal objects with valid layouts and create appropriate View instances that can be used for accessing fields via attribute access and indexing.

requirement.description: Attribute access on Views fails with AttributeError when accessing fields that don't exist or are reserved names.
requirement.contract: View.getattr should properly handle missing attributes by raising AttributeError with helpful error messages, and should correctly handle reserved names (starting with underscore) that should be accessed via indexing.

requirement.description: Indexing on Views fails with TypeError when attempting to access fields that don't exist or using wrong indexing types.
requirement.contract: View.getitem should properly handle missing indices by raising KeyError, and should correctly handle different indexing types with appropriate error messages.

requirement.description: Enum error messages don't match expected format for shape validation warnings and errors.
requirement.contract: Enum validation should produce error messages that match the expected format, including proper handling of signed/unsigned mismatches and value truncation warnings.

requirement.description: Signal reset validation fails to raise ValueError when it should for invalid reset values with shape-castable objects.
requirement.contract: Signal constructor should validate reset values properly for shape-castable objects and raise ValueError when constants are not castable.
